newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's producer price index up 0.6 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's producer price index up 0.6 pct in Sept.

text.p: Colombia's producer price index rose 0.6 percent in September compared to a 0.2 percent increase during the same month last year, the central bank said.
The PPI has risen 12 percent during the first nine months of 1996, down from a 13 percent rise during the same period last year.

As measured on a year-on-year basis, from September 1995 to September 1996, the index has climbed 14.4 percent, down from 17.2 percent in the corresponding 12 months of 1994 and 1995, the central bank said.
Inflation in Colombia is expected to reach at least 21 percent this year, well over the central bank's 17 percent target.
